title: fix(platform-objects): Setup offers Ban/Unban, Revoke/Restore and Unlock by the record's state
body:
Fixes #24760

Clause-②: no (an action's offering: `visible` is judged in the console, and no server door reads it, so no accept set or served shape moves; if the dev measures a door that does, the dev stops, and the seat re-declares)

Dev session `session_01VXimSk38NSs68ntncNxKS8`, dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 (`session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`) under claim 6292572117.

## What changes

Five Setup actions judged only the caller's standing, so both halves of each pair were offered on every row. Each now also reads the record's state, in the form of `sys_oauth_application`'s Disable / Enable pair (`has(record.X) && record.X != true` and `== true`):

| Action | `visible` (authored) |
|---|---|
| `sys_user.ban_user` | `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true && has(record.banned) && record.banned != true` |
| `sys_user.unban_user` | `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true && has(record.banned) && record.banned == true` |
| `sys_user.unlock_user` | `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true && ((has(record.locked_until) && record.locked_until != null) \|\| (has(record.two_factor_enabled) && record.two_factor_enabled == true))` |
| `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` | `has(record.revoked) && record.revoked != true` |
| `sys_api_key.restore_api_key` | `has(record.revoked) && record.revoked == true` |

`requiresFeature: 'admin'` still AND-composes onto the three `sys_user` predicates at parse time. Labels, texts, targets, params and every other key are unchanged, so no translation bundle moves.

## Read before the edit

**Row context.** On a list row (`list_item`), objectui's `ObjectGrid` builds `$select` from the view's columns plus every `record.FIELD` that any of the object's actions reads in `visible` / `disabled`. The read is `listViewPredicates({ objectActions: resolvedSchema.actions })` then `collectPredicateFieldRefs`, in `packages/core/src/utils/predicate-fields.ts` and `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `616df659`. Only fields the object declares are kept. So the default Users view (`name`, `email`, `created_at`) still carries `banned`, `locked_until` and `two_factor_enabled`, and the API Keys views carry `revoked` (also a column there). On the record header (`record_header`), `RecordDetailView` / `DetailView` call `findOne` with no `$select`, which returns the whole row. The console judges `visible` through `@objectstack/formula`'s engine (`fieldRules.ts`, `ExpressionEvaluator`). No objectui change is needed. This is a code reading; I did not boot a showcase, because the code left no doubt.

**Who reads `visible`.** No server door reads it. `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` says so for declarative actions ("Deliberately unread; pinned as unread"), and `domains/actions.ts` says it for the dispatch door ("rendering predicates that no dispatch door reads"). The MCP `list_actions` filter is a system-object filter, not an action's `visible`. Five other sites were read too, and none of them reads `visible`: the ban, unban and unlock routes (`admin-ban-endpoints.ts`, `unlockUser`, the plugin-auth routes), and the `sys_api_key` `PATCH` (`api-key-restore-guard.ts`, the identity write guard). `Clause-②: no` stands.

**States.**
- `banned` / `ban_expires`: better-auth 1.7.3 (`plugins/admin/admin.mjs`, the session-create hook) clears `banned` only when a session is next created after `ban_expires`. Until the user signs in again, the row still says `banned: true`, so Unban stays offered for as long as the row says banned.
- `locked_until` (ADR-0069 D2): the CEL engine *can* compare it with `now()` (measured: an ISO string compared with `now()` gives the right boolean). I chose not to compare it, because `unlockUser` clears two stages. One is this row's `locked_until`; the other is `sys_two_factor.locked_until`, which the user row does not carry. Gating on `locked_until` alone would take away the only early release of a second-factor lock. An expired stamp also leaves `failed_login_count` at the threshold, so one more failure re-locks the account, and Unlock is what resets the counter. So Unlock is offered when `locked_until` is set or when two-factor is enabled. It is hidden on a plain account with neither, which is the case the card reports.
- `revoked` / `revoked_reason`: only a platform administrator may restore a key that a forced password reset revoked. That gate is the server's (`api-key-restore-guard.ts`, a `beforeUpdate` hook), and it stays there. The predicate offers Restore on every revoked key.

## Verification

All on `2740711c4` (main `a7199ef97` merged in), unless noted.

- Evaluated pins: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/action-state-visibility.test.ts`, 11 tests. They evaluate each parsed predicate through `celEngine`, on a banned, unbanned and null row, a row without the field, and a non-admin caller. The same is done for Unlock and the API key pair. The `platform-objects.test.ts` lowering matrix rows for the three `sys_user` actions move to the new sources.
- Ablation, run twice. Each time the restored blob was proven equal to `HEAD` with `git hash-object` and `git diff HEAD` came back empty.
  - Leg 1: both object files restored to base `a8b44d40`. Result: 2 files failed. The new pin file fails at collection, because base `revoke_api_key` has no `visible`. The 3 lowering rows also fail.
  - Leg 2: only `sys-user.object.ts` reverted. Result: 5 of 11 tests failed: Ban/Unban not-banned, banned, unprojected; Unlock no-lock; Unlock unprojected.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0. The first run exited 1 on 4 TS2345 errors in the new test file; I fixed them by typing the principal.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: exit 0, 82 files, 1232 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: exit 0, 171 files, 3277 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: exit 0, 6 files, 82 tests.
- `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts` and `action-predicate-sparse-face.test.ts`: green. The standing leg stays, and every new `record.*` read opens with `has()`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `2740711c4`: 66 commands, all exit 0. `--ran`: "66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). After `pnpm build` they were re-run and exited 0.
  - `check:type-check-debt` ran in a `nohup` slice waited on by PID, and exited 0.
  - The clone was deepened with `--shallow-since=2026-07-13` before the run.

## Pin sweep

The five action names and their `visible` strings were swept across every package, `qa/`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` and `content/docs/`. The only pins that move are the three `platform-objects.test.ts` lowering rows. Everything else is unaffected:
- the dogfood API-key lifecycle tests, `api-key-lifecycle.test.ts`, `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` and the `identity-auth.json` checklist items: they issue the PATCH directly and never read `visible`;
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`: its `ban_user` example shows only `requiresFeature`;
- the confirm-dialog pins and `action-execution-destructive.test.ts`: they do not read `visible`.

No `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` edit.

## Acceptance notes

- `origin/main` moved 3 commits after the merge (`eee65afc8`, `e2c2355af`, `81e6edd46`: driver-sql and dogfood), none touching `platform-objects`. They were not merged.
- A row can show an expired timed ban as banned until the user's next sign-in. Ban is then hidden; Unban and then Ban re-bans. This follows better-auth's lazy clear and is not changed here.
- The console judges `visible` on the row it holds, so a lock that expires while the page is open is not re-judged until the row is re-read.
